hypothesis: Host reports capture complete before all exposure-owned candidates are reconciled
evidence_if_true: Pending candidate exists at next shutter and failure rate changes with reconciliation
evidence_if_false: All candidates terminal before host completion across reproductions

hypothesis: A fixed timer/watchdog initiates failures during legitimate long Pentax work
evidence_if_true: Sharp boundary around timer and timer action precedes session divergence
evidence_if_false: No timer action precedes failures and boundary sweep is smooth

hypothesis: Preview or another foreign command races the active capture lifecycle
evidence_if_true: Controlled command injection reproduces first divergence while no-injection baseline survives
evidence_if_false: Injected commands do not change failure rate/state

hypothesis: Stale session state is primarily aftermath rather than initiating cause
evidence_if_true: Another event consistently precedes stale-session observation
evidence_if_false: Stale session appears first from clean baseline without prior divergence

hypothesis: pgphoto accumulates resources/state across successful captures
evidence_if_true: Resource/state trend correlates with shot number and failure probability
evidence_if_false: Resources and latency remain bounded across soak

hypothesis: Physical USB failure initiates the common field crash
evidence_if_true: USB identity/transport diverges before PTP/app state
evidence_if_false: PTP/app state fails while USB identity/transport remains stable

hypothesis: Embedded pgphoto/runtime integration is required to reproduce the failure
evidence_if_true: Polaris path fails while equivalent direct libgphoto2 path survives
evidence_if_false: Direct path reproduces same first divergence
